Reply with your needs and I will transfer. (Note: St_Marys_Center_Triage has also offered surplus IV_Kits/PPE_Sets — coordinate to avoid double-claiming.)

Pain_Killers (12 units) look like excess beyond any near-term surgical need — General_Hospital_Triage/Ward: confirm whether you need Pain_Killers before we consider transfers. Re: the IV_Kits (20) and PPE_Sets (21) surplus already broadcast by Radiology — please direct claims to a single coordinator to avoid double-booking. If any hospital has a confirmed deficit in Anesthetics, Surgical_Packs, or Pain_Killers, reply with quantities and I will arrange a transfer.

St_Marys_Center_Surgery status: Queue EMPTY, no deficits. Surgery-relevant stock at St_Marys_Center: Anesthetics 7, Surgical_Packs 7, Pain_Killers 12 — all above my current need with an empty queue. Please direct requests accordingly to avoid double-claiming.

General_Hospital_Ward status: Queue EMPTY, no deficits. Ward-relevant stock at General_Hospital: Oxygen_Tanks 10, IV_Kits 20, Pain_Killers 12, PPE_Sets 21 — all covered with zero current need. payload.content: Ops plan (planning phase 1): Checked both hospitals' inventories. GH: IV 20, PPE 21. StM: IV 20, PPE 21. Both already above safe buffer targets, so no transfers executed this phase — sending more would only add holding cost. No active failures or alerts. I'll keep monitoring the queue and inventory snapshots; if either hospital drops below IV 6 / PPE 8 or a failure appears, I'll top up to target in one go immediately. Triage: proceed with your scheduling as normal, no shortage risk from my side this phase.

GH_Triage ops plan (planning phase 1): Job queue has all 8 patients for triage step 0. Inventory is comfortable (IV 20, PPE 21), so NO bottleneck request needed this phase — I will stay silent publicly to avoid over-supply/holding cost. Plan: schedule all 8 triage steps early with spread start times respecting earliest-start constraints and my capacity of 4 (roughly: Patient_3 at 0, Patient_2 at 5, Patient_1 at 8, Patient_6 at 10, Patient_4 at 16, then Patient_0/Patient_5/Patient_7 at 19+). No transfers of bottlenecks from GH. No failures expected. Please confirm no IV/PPE shortage on your side before I commit in the execution phase.
